content.comment_body: Hello. I have a question regarding analog input settings on the basic [product_name] module. There's an option to enable inputs as analog: no AI; enable 2 AIs - AI1 and AI2 as I7 and I8; enable 4 AIs - AI1, AI2 as I7, I8 and AI3, AI4 as I1, I2. Is it possible to configure I7 for analog signal as AI1, while keeping I8 as a standard digital input if I select 'Enable 2 AIs'? Thank you.
This isn't an issue. Activating analog input simply reserves addresses AI1 and AI2. You can still use terminal I8 as a digital input if you prefer.

For specific applications, you may be able to use I1, I2, I7, and I8 as both analog and digital inputs simultaneously. Digital input functionality remains active; low signal is below 5V, high is above 8.5V. Regards, [user_name]
Thank you for the quick responses!

analysis.insight_summary: Participants discussed flexible assignment and usage of analog and digital input settings on a [product_name] basis module. The conversation explored whether certain terminals can serve dual functions, with users expressing uncertainty over configuration logic. Replies indicated some flexibility, though improved clarity in official documentation would be beneficial.
analysis.user_expectations: Users expect to flexibly assign analog input channels to specific terminals while maintaining the ability to use other terminals as standard digital inputs, even when the analog input function is enabled.
